proposals.evidence: Full cikkaṇa gives Oriya cikaṇa/cikaṇā oil or ghee, Bihari ciknā oil seeds/ghee, Assamese sikaṇ smooth and Bengali cikan. Eastern cikən/cikon/cikoṇ/sikon oil responses fit this documented adjective-to-oil family; retain the local affricate/sibilant realization and qualify cross-IA transmission. Exact response: sikon.
